name: vectorworks
description: Skills for driving Vectorworks 2024/2025 through the vectorworks MCP server (registered separately by install.ps1).

interface.shortDescription: Draw, inspect, edit, capture and export Vectorworks drawings
interface.longDescription: Teaches Codex the 10 Vectorworks MCP tools: status first, document targeting, one-call floor plans with walls, doors, windows and spaces, edits, visual verification with vw_capture, layers and classes, sheet export, multi-document work, scripting and recovery for every error code. The MCP server itself is registered by install.ps1 as [mcp_servers.vectorworks].
defaultPrompt: Check the Vectorworks connection and summarize the active drawing.
Draw a 8 x 6 m two-room floor plan with doors, windows and spaces in the active Vectorworks document.
Export all sheets of the active Vectorworks document to PDF on my desktop.
